review_description: Punctual, tidy, professionalOnly charged wholesale on system, cash for worker to install in weekend. - all above board, just a way for business to allow staff to earn extra out of hours, hence why so cheap. All certified, certified electricians and got my solar warranties and certificate. I asked for black racking system and they installed for me for no extra cost.Other quotes received were up around 7-10k fir same system paying retail prices.
